name: Nagashino Castle
description: Nagashino Castle was the stage of the 1575 Battle of Nagashino, where Oda Nobunaga's firearms defeated Takeda Katsuyori's cavalry — a turning point in Japanese military history. The river-bluff ruins and museum mark the site.
notes: The Nagashino Castle Historic Site Museum (¥210) sets the scene; the ruins are free.

ja.name: 長篠城
ja.description: 1575年の長篠の戦いの舞台。織田信長の鉄砲隊が武田勝頼を破った戦場跡が、断崖の城跡と資料館で紹介されています。
ja.notes: 長篠城址史跡保存館（大人210円）で解説。城跡は無料です。
